foot.note: Your videos go straight to your computer over this Wi-Fi, never through the internet.
pair.title: Connect to your computer
pair.lede: Type the PIN shown next to the QR code on your computer.
pair.ledeCode: Type the setup code and the PIN shown on your computer.
pair.expired: This phone’s connection to your computer ran out. Type the PIN your computer shows now.
code.hint: Eight letters and numbers, shown on your computer.
pin.hint: Six digits, shown on your computer.
pair.error.rejected: That PIN didn’t match. Check the digits on your computer and try again.
pair.error.network: Can’t reach your computer. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi, then try again.
pair.error.closed: Your computer isn’t listening yet. In Taalcut’s Library, click From your phone, then try again.
pair.error.full: Five phones are already connected to your computer.
pair.help: Can’t see a PIN? On your computer, open Taalcut, go to Library and click From your phone. If it shows a new QR code, scan that one.
choose.lede: Pick as many as you like. Each one goes into your computer’s library as it arrives.
send.title: Sending to your computer
error.unauthorized: Your computer needs you to connect again.
error.forbidden: Your computer turned this video away. Try again in a moment.
error.tooLarge: This video is too big for your computer.
error.notMedia: Your computer only takes videos and photos.
error.diskFull: Your computer is out of space. Free some up, then try again.
error.importFailed: Your computer couldn’t add it to the library. Try again.
done.title: All on your computer
done.lede: Everything is in your computer’s library. You can close this page.
done.ledeSome: Your computer couldn’t take the rest. Each one says why.
lost.body: Your phone can’t reach your computer. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi. Videos carry on from where they stopped.
waiting.title: Waiting for your computer
waiting.body: On your computer, open Taalcut, go to Library and click From your phone. This page carries on by itself.
